uplink.description: heartbeat, no leak on any of the four channels, battery ok
uplink._note: Input is the upstream TTN heartbeat example (reference/upstream-examples.json). Upstream oracle: monitorStatus true, alarmChannel1..4 all false, alarmBattery false, temperature 25, frameCounter 0 (bytes[12]=0xF0 = all four channel status bits SET = active-LOW so no alarm). expected.data authored to the normalized vocabulary: one channels[] entry per channel carrying water.leak, with the single whole-device temperature left top-level.

uplink.description: channels differ: only channel2 is wet, the other three dry (per-position truth, unrepresentable in the old any-channel OR)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame derived from the upstream heartbeat example with bytes[12] changed to 0xB0 (= 0x80|0x20|0x10) and a distinct temperature/frame counter. Cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js field extraction: only the channel-3 status bit (0x40) is clear, so active-LOW gives alarmChannel3 true and alarmChannel1/2/4 false -> the zero-based entry channel2 is the wet one; low nibble 0 -> alarmBattery false; bytes[13..14]=0,7 -> frameCounter 7. This is the case the retired top-level any-channel OR could not express: three dry channels are hidden behind one wet one.

uplink.description: leak alarm on channels 1 and 3 (entries channel0 and channel2), low battery, temp 18C
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame. bytes[12]=0xAF: the channel-1 (0x10) and channel-3 (0x40) status bits are clear = active-LOW alarm = leak on entries channel0/channel2; low nibble 0xF = low-battery flag. bytes[13..14]=1,44 -> frameCounter 300. expected.data cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js field extraction and normalized to the vocabulary; batteryLow / monitorEnabled / frameCounter and the single device temperature are whole-device readings and stay top-level.

uplink.description: parameter report frame carries no measurement

errors: parameter report frame carries no normalized measurement

uplink._note: Input is the upstream TTN parameter-packet example (bytes[3]==0x03). Upstream decodes it to device settings (firmware/uploadInterval/batteryThreshold/monitorStatus); these are not normalized measurements, so our codec reports an error and emits no `channels` key.
